title: OpenAI pauses frontier RL training for stronger cyber safeguards
summary: OpenAI paused a frontier reinforcement-learning run while strengthening isolation and monitoring.
content: The company says an upcoming model may meet a critical cybersecurity capability threshold. The largest planned frontier RL run remains on hold.

title: DeepSeek releases V4 Flash Vision experimental API
summary: The experimental model adds image inputs to the V4 Flash agent API.
content: It supports Chat Completions, Messages and Responses APIs. Images can be supplied by URL, base64 or Files API.
